motive.zhHans: 事后揭示，四年前传说里的那位「魔女」其实正是佐藤——她把爱车 Mazda RX-7（FD3S）从纯白改成了酒红，以免在雾中发生事故；而那声女性的尖叫也是她发出的，因为那能帮她在弯道转向，男人们根本模仿不来——所以 Mafune 无论怎么努力，都做不出同样的声音。
motive.en: It is revealed afterwards that Sato was the witch spoken of in the legend four years ago and that she change the color of her Mazda RX-7 (FD3S) from Pure white to Vintage red to avoid accidents in the fog and that the sound of women screaming was done also by her since it helped her turn in curves which made it impossible for men to repeat it which is why no matter how hard he tried Mafune could never produce the same sound.

method.zhHans: 他揭示，他们在雾中用一支钓竿挂起一盏红色头灯，制造出前方无路可走的错觉。Egashira 与 Mafune 交代，他们利用魔女的传说把赛车手们吓退，不再上山飙车，但他们从没向那位巡查的祖母挥过手。多起汽车事故（旧案）。地点：群马县冬名山。死因：车祸。犯人：Raito Egashira 与 Akira Mafune。他们在山上与许多人竞速，并用那声「魔女的尖叫」让对手撞车。
method.en: He reveals they hung a red headlight on a fishing rod in the fog to create the image they are turning into a road-less area. Egashira and Mafune reveal that they used the legend of the witch to scare racers from racing on the mountain but they never waved to the inspector's grandmother. Multiple Car Accidents (Past) Location: Mount Fuyuna, Gunma Cause of death: Car crash Culprits: Raito Egashira and Akira Mafune They raced against a lot of people in the mountains and used the witch's sound to make their opponents crash.

evidence.zhHans: 犯人被揭示为 Raito Egashira 与 Akira Mafune。柯南揭示，那位祖母看到的是「布罗肯幽灵」——其实是她自己挥手时的倒影。事后揭示，四年前传说里的那位「魔女」其实正是佐藤——她把爱车 Mazda RX-7（FD3S）从纯白改成了酒红，以免在雾中发生事故；而那声女性的尖叫也是她发出的，因为那能帮她在弯道转向，男人们根本模仿不来——所以 Mafune 无论怎么努力，都做不出同样的声音。
evidence.en: The culprits are revealed to be Raito Egashira and Akira Mafune. Conan revealed that the grandmother saw a "Brocken Spectre" which is a reflection of the grandmother waving at herself. It is revealed afterwards that Sato was the witch spoken of in the legend four years ago and that she change the color of her Mazda RX-7 (FD3S) from Pure white to Vintage red to avoid accidents in the fog and that the sound of women screaming was done also by her since it helped her turn in curves which made it impossible for men to repeat it which is why no matter how hard he tried Mafune could never produce the same sound.

resolution.zhHans: 第二天，柯南揭示那对带着钓具的人是犯人。他揭示，他们在雾中用一支钓竿挂起一盏红色头灯，制造出前方无路可走的错觉。犯人被揭示为 Raito Egashira 与 Akira Mafune。他们现身向小五郎挑战竞速，却在遇到路障时被逮住。Egashira 与 Mafune 交代，他们利用魔女的传说把赛车手们吓退，不再上山飙车，但他们从没向那位巡查的祖母挥过手。柯南揭示，那位祖母看到的是「布罗肯幽灵」——其实是她自己挥手时的倒影。多起汽车事故（旧案）。地点：群马县冬名山。
resolution.en: The next day Conan reveals the pair with the fishing gear to be the culprit. He reveals they hung a red headlight on a fishing rod in the fog to create the image they are turning into a road-less area. The culprits are revealed to be Raito Egashira and Akira Mafune. They appear and challenge Kogoro to a race but are caught when they come upon a road block. Egashira and Mafune reveal that they used the legend of the witch to scare racers from racing on the mountain but they never waved to the inspector's grandmother. Conan revealed that the grandmother saw a "Brocken Spectre" which is a reflection of the grandmother waving at herself. Multiple Car Accidents (Past) Location: Mount Fuyuna, Gunma
